settings.uiFontHint: The app interface font. Comma-separated families; the first one your system has is used. Blank uses the built-in default.

settings.apiKeyHint: Stored in its own secured file, not in settings. A {variable} environment variable, if set, takes precedence over the saved key.
settings.geminiModelsHint: Your model list — add any Gemini model id here, remove ones you don't use. The two selectors below pick from this list; to use a new model, add it here first. An invalid or retired id is reported when a job runs, not here.
settings.transcriptionModelHint: Used for transcription and structured transcription. Choose a capable model for long audio.
settings.metadataModelHint: Used for title and slug generation. A lighter model is fine for short text tasks.
settings.concurrentTranscriptionsHint: Maximum number of audio transcription jobs that can run at once. Each job loads a full audio file into the AI context, so keep this low unless you have a high API quota.
settings.maxRetriesHint: Maximum number of retry attempts per AI call.
settings.initialRetryDelayHint: Wait time before the first retry.
settings.maxRetryDelayHint: Upper bound on retry wait time.
settings.retryJitterHint: Randomness added to retry delays to avoid thundering herd.
settings.transcriptionTimeoutHint: Time allowed per transcription or structured transcription request.
settings.metadataTimeoutHint: Time allowed for each title or slug generation request.
